title: Review of well-posedness methods for the 1D nonlinear Schrödinger equation with an application to combined nonlinearities
summary: We consider the nonlinear Schrödinger equation in one dimension with nonlinearities of type $|u|^αu$ for any power $α>0$ and review two different methods for obtaining solutions, namely, local well-posedness, with initial data either in $L^2$ or $H^1$, or in the weighted subspace of $H^1$. One approach is based on the Strichartz estimates, and thus, $H^1$ well-posedness typically holds for nonlinearities with power $α\geq 1$.
